brief:
Israeli settler militias attacked a Palestinian home in the village of Khalayel al-Louz, south of Bethlehem, at dawn today, Eye on Palestine reported. The assault caused substantial structural damage to the residence, according to documentation of the aftermath.

The attack marks another incident of settler violence in the region surrounding Bethlehem, where Palestinian communities have faced repeated confrontations with armed militia groups. Khalayel al-Louz sits in an area that has experienced periodic tensions between Palestinian residents and Israeli settlers operating in the West Bank.

title: Israeli settler militias attack Palestinian home south of Bethlehem
